title: Nine Mile Guest Ranch & RV/Campground

services.name: Events and Day Use
services.desc: Our Day-Use areas are perfect for hosting your family reunion, club luncheon, ward activity, or simply a great place to stop to stretch your legs and visit with our resident Cowboy Ben. Recently featured on Utah’s At Your Leisure show! Our green open yard area provides ample space to fit any size event. If you want something more intimate, our grove of trees offers a beautiful backdrop. The rustic pavilion with serving area and kitchen provides a perfect place for your gatherings. Come celebrate your special day here at the ranch in a beautiful outdoor space that will be unforgettable! See our available packages with pricing below.
